protocol_limitations: The same Orca TUI terminal process was reused sequentially. The adapter did not expose Codex thread IDs and no /new operation was verified, so conversational-context independence between v1 and v2 is unproven and v2 may have had the v1 transcript available. Candidate files were reset to the same baseline between conditions.
The Codex TUI parent ran on the host; only tool children used harness-eval. This is not evidence of VM isolation.
Exact thread/turn IDs, token counts, shell command counts, and subagent-turn counts were not exposed.
evidence_note: Both candidate runs used the identical task and prompt hashes, model/reasoning, baseline snapshot and 30-minute budget. Host grading was independent and offline. No successful network or live service calls, remote CI, push, publication, or merge occurred.
